  AGENDA

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the November 22, 2021, meeting.

  2. Guy Black – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing artist
  booking services for the Tree Lighting Ceremony.

  3. Hannibal Media Group – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  artist booking services and advertising for the Tree Lighting Ceremony.

  4. James C Johnson – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for designing and
  coordinating a drive-thru Halloween Spooktacular for the City.

  5. Rhonda Davis - Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing virtual
  Zumba services for Inglewood residents.

  6. Data Center Solutions, Inc – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  providing emergency repairs of the Inglewood Emergency Operation Center. EOC UPS.

  7. Bayside Medical Center – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for pre-
  employment physical tests services provided to the Human Resources Department.

  8. Monjaras & Wismeyer Group, Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommend payment
  for consulting and ergonomic evaluation services for the Human Resource Department.

  9. Hillcrest Medical Clinic – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for medical
  services and DMV exams for the Human Resources Department.
 Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

  Adjournment.
